parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Carry out a correct method for finding a vector equation for $m$. M1. Obtain $\mathbf{r}=\begin{pmatrix}1\\5\\3\end{pmatrix}+\lambda\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\\2\end{pmatrix}$. A1. Or $\mathbf{r}=\begin{pmatrix}0\\4\\1\end{pmatrix}+\lambda\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\\2\end{pmatrix}$ OE. Must have $\mathbf{r}=\ldots$. Total: [2]

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Express a general point of the second line in component form, i.e. $(1+2\mu,-3-2\mu,1+3\mu)$. B1. Or $(3+2\mu,-5-2\mu,4+3\mu)$. Equate at least two pairs of corresponding components and solve for $\lambda$ or $\mu$. M1. Obtain $\lambda=-4$ or $\mu=-2$. A1. If $m$ has direction vector $(-1,-1,-2)$, then $\lambda=4$; if line $CD$ has direction vector $(-2,2,-3)$, then $\mu=2$. Obtain position vector $\begin{pmatrix}-3\\1\\-5\end{pmatrix}$. A1; accept coordinates. Total: [4]

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Find $\overrightarrow{CP}$ for a general point $P$ on $m$, e.g. $\begin{pmatrix}0\\8\\2\end{pmatrix}+\lambda\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\\2\end{pmatrix}$. B1. Or $\begin{pmatrix}-1\\7\\0\end{pmatrix}+\lambda\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\\2\end{pmatrix}$. Calculate the scalar product of $\overrightarrow{CP}$ and a direction vector for $m$ and equate the result to zero. M1. Obtain $\lambda=-2$. A1 OE. Obtain $\begin{pmatrix}-1\\3\\-1\end{pmatrix}$. A1 OE. Total: [4]
